## Real API integration, not copy/paste (like Phase 3/4/10)

No Claude prompt here — this pulls real numbers from the YouTube
Analytics API v2 and writes them into `analytics_snapshots`. This is
what unblocks Phase 9 (Analytics Agent) for real — Phase 9 refuses to
run on empty data, and until this workflow has run at least once for a
channel, that table stays empty.

Requires the same **YouTube OAuth2 API** credential as Phase 10 — see
`YOUTUBE-OAUTH-SETUP.md`. Also untested against a real account for the
same reason as Phase 10 (no OAuth credential existed at build time,
2026-09-02) — the report shape (`columnHeaders`/`rows` arrays) matches
Google's documented Analytics API v2 response format, but hasn't been
verified against a real response.

## Only reports on videos that exist in both places

The Analytics API returns rows keyed by YouTube's own video ID. This
workflow joins those back to our internal `videos.id` via
`videos.youtube_video_id` (set by Phase 10 on a successful upload) —
any YouTube video in the report that isn't a `youtube_video_id` we
recognize is silently skipped, not errored, since it likely just means
something was uploaded outside this pipeline.

## Window: last 30 days, by video

`startDate`/`endDate` cover a rolling 30-day window ending today.
`retention_pct` is populated from YouTube's `averageViewPercentage`
metric (0-100), the closest real equivalent the API offers — not the
full per-second retention curve Agent #11's prompt describes, since
that needs the separate (undocumented-for-third-parties) audience
retention report. Flagged here rather than silently approximated
without comment.

## Before running this

1. Complete `YOUTUBE-OAUTH-SETUP.md` first.
2. Set `channels.youtube_channel_id` for the channel.
3. Reuses **Supabase account** for `/rest/v1/...` nodes, and the
   **YouTube account** OAuth2 credential for the
   `youtubeanalytics.googleapis.com` node — wire both.
4. Activate, open the Form Trigger's Production URL (or let the
   Schedule Trigger run it — left INACTIVE by default, same reasoning
   as Phase 4B), enter the exact Channel Name.

parameters.formDescription: Phase 11: pulls real YouTube Analytics data for the last 30 days into analytics_snapshots. Enter the exact Channel Name.
